data.comment: Refused before any embedding, which is the whole of #397: the same arithmetic used to fail inside Assemble as an OutOfMemoryException from new float[(long)totalChunks * dim], after every chunk had already been embedded. All three holes are counts and stay invariant. {0} is the chunk total the finished index would hold - fresh plus reused, the same tally Assemble makes - not BuildChunked's count of what is left to embed: on an incremental build the two differ by orders of magnitude, and the smaller one printed beside the ceiling reads as a limit that was not reached. {1} is Array.MaxLength / {2}, computed rather than written down, so the sentence cannot drift from the limit it describes. It is an upper bound and nothing else: a build well under it can still exhaust the machine, which is why the line says at most and promises nothing below it. The dimension is carried because it is what makes the ceiling a quotient rather than a product constant - another embedding model gives another ceiling for the same tree, and this is the figure that says why. No colon anywhere: what stands left of the first colon is a field name and stays English, and this sentence is translated whole. The noun stands before the figure in Russian - чанков {0}, не больше {1} - for the reason BuildEmbeddingStopped and RoslynOpened already do it: an invariant number agrees with no case ending otherwise. No remedy clause, and deliberately - nothing this product offers moves any of the three things that would help. localai sync takes --root, --base-only, --require-semantics and --max-inline-files and no path filter; FileScanner's exclusions are a fixed list plus git ls-files --exclude-standard; and the embedding model comes from the routing catalogue rather than from localai policy set. Naming any of them would name a route the reader cannot take. What stands in the remedy's place is the one thing he would otherwise do, and it is the exact negation of BuildEmbeddingStopped's second clause: that line says a repeated run continues from where it stopped, this one says it stops in the same place.

data.comment: The one place in the semantic phase where a fraction is a fact rather than a guess: the project count is known before the first iteration, and it is the same figure RoslynOpened printed a moment earlier, so 7/26 closes against a number the reader has already seen. Printed after the project it counts, not before it - 1/26 before the work is a promise. Throttled by elapsed time rather than by every Nth project, because a per-N rule is wrong at both ends; a fast analysis therefore prints this line no times at all, which is why RoslynAnalysed prints unconditionally.
